outputs.explanation: Panel A contains an H&E micrograph plus spatial transcriptomic expression maps (Tmprss11b, Krt13, Krt6a) rendered as color-coded heatmap overlays on tissue. Heatmap-type visualizations are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel B consists entirely of micrographs (H&E and RNAscope fluorescence images), with no plot summarizing averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a scatter plot showing median with 95% CI, and every individual patient data point (LUAD and LUSC) is plotted as a dot, satisfying the requirement to show underlying data.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with individual replicate values (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots, so the underlying data points are visible alongside the summary statistic.
